Prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] sent [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] and the Chancellor's personal aide, [[Silman/Legends|Silman]], on a '''mission''' to [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]] to resolve a crisis within the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]]. The mission led to Sifo-Dyas' death, as the [[Pyke/Legends|Pykes]] were paid by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to kill the Jedi Master.
